description: Pinned upstream sources and expected artifact hashes for the Hanzi Writer-enhanced Japanese Zinnia model. Read by scripts/build_hzw_model_package.py and tests/licensing_check_test.py. See PROVENANCE.md.

derived_from: Make Me a Hanzi graphics.txt (https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi), Arphic-1999
Arphic PL KaitiM GB and Arphic PL UKai fonts (as stated by the Make Me a Hanzi README)

tegaki_zinnia_japanese.role: training data (Tomoe stroke templates) and production model

zinnia.role: trainer (zinnia_learn) and recognition engine; not training data
zinnia.local_patch: svm.cpp: std::random_shuffle replaced by std::shuffle with std::mt19937 seeded 0

equivalent_copies.3a5e90c0957524a89e48203febcd4492ca439367: hanzi-writer-data APL/english/ARPHICPL.TXT; makemeahanzi APL/english/ARPHICPL.TXT; SPDX license-list-data text/Arphic-1999.txt (same text plus a final newline)

LGPL-2.1.txt.origin: tegaki-zinnia-japanese 0.3 tarball, /COPYING (byte-exact copy; identical to the COPYING of tegaki-zinnia-traditional-chinese 0.3)

training.selection: every character present in both Tegaki Japanese 0.3 and Hanzi Writer data, in code point order

expected_sha256.comment: Corpus hashes are over the data lines only (notice header lines starting with ';' removed). The model hash was reproduced on macOS arm64 / AppleClang; other platforms are not verified and may differ in floating-point results.
